# VANTAGE USMC

VANTAGE (also described as VANTAGE USMC) is an independent, self-hosted performance, productivity, readiness, work tracking, reporting, and team decision-support platform.

## Public website
- https://vantageusmc.com/

## What Vantage does
Vantage helps operational teams capture work, organize actions and outcomes, track goals and readiness, manage spreadsheet-supported work queues and correspondence, build reports, and understand individual and team performance from traceable source records.

## Core capabilities
- Performance and action tracking
- Work and project management
- Spreadsheet-supported queues
- Goals and measurable progress
- Readiness tracking
- Correspondence tracking
- Report creation and source-linked analysis
- Team and unit visibility
- Role-aware access
- Self-hosted deployment controls
- AI-assisted workflows embedded where work happens

## Important clarification
Vantage is an independent software project. It is not an official Department of Defense or U.S. Marine Corps system of record.
